subject: Kickoff: Ledge interpretable-commands evaluation
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the Ledge track. Our Interpretable Actions release (AAAI-21) controls expert models with understandable commands, and the shipped Function Approximator example walks steps 3 through 5: correct the residual error, extract the interpretable commands to console, then fine-tune the extracted commands. The product question for data-platforms: can that command-extraction loop become an interpretability layer we offer alongside model hosting, so customers see *why* an expert did what it did?

Plan: reproduce the 1-D reconstruction demo (targets/approximate_20) by Apr 3, then swap in three internal target functions and measure refit error by mid-May, decision review in late June.

Ivo owns staffing; Tereza is tech lead. First working session Thursday.

Dmitri
